item.title: Robot Orders Increase in Q2 as Automation Demand Broadens Across Industries
item.description: The second-quarter growth in North American robot orders and revenue indicates accelerating commercial investments in factory automation, which directly drives demand for integrated machine vision systems.

item.title: Fraunhofer Advances In-Line Packaging Inspection with Optical Coherence Tomography
item.description: The development of non-destructive optical coherence tomography by Fraunhofer addresses the growing commercial need for high-speed, reliable inline defect detection in strict regulatory sectors like food and medical packaging.

item.title: Neuralyze Brings the Complete Vision AI Workflow into One Software Platform
item.description: senswork's release of the Neuralyze platform represents a commercial move toward making advanced deep learning inspection capabilities more accessible and standalone for industrial quality assurance.

item.title: Scantron Advances Automated Surface Defect Detection with Proscan DDMS 3D Line
item.description: Scantron's introduction of the Proscan DDMS 3D Line offers a robust hardware solution that enhances automated surface defect detection for industrial quality control applications.

item.title: Callista Acquires Zero Touch Metrology from Sandvik Group
item.description: Callista's acquisition of Zero Touch Metrology signals ongoing consolidation and market shifts within the industrial quality control sector.

item.title: Automated Optical Inspection System Market to Reach USD 2.26 Billion by 2035 - EIN Presswire
item.description: The Automated Optical Inspection system market's expected growth to 2.26 Billion highlights increasing commercial reliance on machine vision solutions across industries.

item.title: Verisurf to Showcase Verisurf 2027 and Future of Model-Based Metrology at IMTS 2026
item.description: Verisurf's showcase of model-based metrology highlights commercial advancements in turnkey defect recognition systems for the manufacturing industry.
